content:
We have bulk Si structure (mp-149) and CO2 molecule (mp-644607). Need to generate slab with given Miller index (1,1,1), min slab size 12 Å, vacuum 5 Å. Then select slab index 0. Then identify adsorption sites, choose ontop site index 0. Then place CO2 at height 2.0 Å above surface. Finally output combined structure CIF file path.

We have functions: enumerate_slabs_text, choose_slab_text, get_adsorption_sites_text, choose_adsorption_site_text, add_adsorbate_to_slab_text.

Proceed stepwise.

First enumerate slabs: need bulk CIF string (we have). Use enumerate_slabs_text with Miller index [1,1,1] and min_slab_size 12, min_vacuum_size 5.
